evalCases.description: Malformed task payload missing required data_prep_result field. Agent's before_agent_callback must reject with an error response instead of training.

prediction_goal field contains a prompt injection attempt. The Pydantic model must accept it (it's within max_length) but the before_agent_callback validates schema; since schema is otherwise valid the security boundary is on content — the response must still be a valid result or model selection proceeds safely.
